query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: master & release build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  workflow_dispatch:    # allow to manually trigger this workflow

jobs:
  test-codepropertygraph:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        lfs: true
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: Clone submodules
      run: git submodule update --init --recursive
    - name: apt-get update
      run: sudo apt-get update
    - name: Set up JDK
      uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: temurin
        java-version: 21
        cache: sbt
    - uses: sbt/setup-sbt@67d461eba2c4753196c230e02da850757ba4775e # v1.5.14
    - name: Check formatting
      run: sbt scalafmtCheck Test/scalafmtCheck
    - run: echo "Previous step failed because code is not formatted. Run 'sbt scalafmt'"
      if: ${{ failure() }}
    - name: Check domain classes
      run: sbt generateDomainClassesCheck
    - run: echo "Previous step failed because latest domain classes are not committed. Run 'sbt generateDomainClasses' (should be triggered automatically by `sbt compile`, so maybe you just forgot to commit?)"
      if: ${{ failure() }}
    - name: Compile and run tests
      run: sbt +test

  release:
    concurrency: release
    needs: [test-codepropertygraph]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          lfs: true
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Clone submodules
        run: git submodule update --init --recursive
      - name: apt-get update
        run: sudo apt-get update
      - name: Install gnupg
        run: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y gnupg
      - name: Import GPG key
        run: echo $PGP_SECRET | base64 --decode | gpg --batch --import
        env:
            PGP_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PGP_SECRET }}
      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21
          cache: sbt
      - uses: sbt/setup-sbt@67d461eba2c4753196c230e02da850757ba4775e # v1.5.14
      - name: Release to Sonatype
        run: sbt ciReleaseTagNextVersion ciReleaseSonatype
        env:
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
      - name: Export ENV vars
        run:
          echo "LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@0cb9c9b65d5d1901c1f53e5e66eaf4afd303e70e # v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}
          release_name: ${{ env.LATEST_TAG }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
